messages:
elena_csm: Hey team — Citrine Labs renewal for account CL-001 is due next week. They verbally agreed to +20 seats but their procurement is pushing for a 9‑month term instead of 12, and they need split invoices across two entities (EU/US). They also requested our SOC2 cert and a revised quote with vendor code. Can we do 9mo as a one‑time prorate? They need PO + signed SOW. cc @leo_legal @anya_finance

jason_revenue: We can do 9mo if we treat it as a midterm amendment with prorated pricing. Will need legal sign‑off on term length and revenue recognition. How many seats total? :thinking:

elena_csm: 120 seats total w/ 20 add-on. They want invoicing split 70/30 across EU entity (VAT) and US. PO requested for the full amount. They've asked for net45 on the EU entity which is new.

anya_finance: Net45 on EU entity raises tax flow issues, need PO with vendor code and VAT treatment clarified. If we split invoices, we need two invoices with separate billing entities in Stripe — requires account ops config. I can do it but need vendor code from procurement.

leo_legal: Quick read — 9mo is fine as a one‑off amendment. Need to ensure the MSA amendment preserves indemnities. Also confirm whether they require data residency language; if so, that'll add time. I'm good to draft the amendment, send to their counsel. ETA 24h.

marco_onboard: Onboarding team: if they sign 9mo with prorate, we can align kickoff immediately after signed SOW. Need to confirm the start date. Also need to capture feature flags for EU tenant provisioning.

procurement_bot: New incoming message from citrine_ap@procure.com: "PO incoming, will send PO#98765 once vendor code confirmed." (attachment: po_request.pdf)

elena_csm: Ok — action items: (1) @anya_finance confirm invoice split feasibility + whether Stripe needs new billing entity (2) @leo_legal draft 9mo amendment + SOW redlines (3) @jason_revenue confirm pricing math for prorate and update quote link: https://app.redwood.ai/quotes/CL-9876 (4) I'll chase procurement for vendor code and updated PO. Please add estimates inline.

anya_finance: Confirmed — we can invoice split 70/30 but revenue ops will need subaccount created. Turnaround ~2 business days. VAT: will mark EU invoice as VAT reverse-charge if they provide EU VAT ID.

jason_revenue: Prorate calc: current annual price $240k base + $40k add-on => annual $280k. For 9mo we bill 75% = $210k. Split 70/30 => EU $147k, US $63k. I'll attach revised quote and show line items for PO.

leo_legal: Drafted amendment and SOW with 9mo term and standard indemnities. Pushed to DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123

elena_csm: One more Q — procurement said they can't e‑sign via DocuSign and prefer emailed countersign by their finance contact. Any objections to emailed countersignature? :question:

leo_legal: Emailed countersign is acceptable here; we'll include clause for signature method. No blocker.

marco_onboard: Once signed, I'll trigger onboarding checklist and set EU tenant provisioning task. Please include start date in SOW.

elena_csm: I'll update thread when PO arrives. Thanks all :pray:

procurement_bot: PO received: PO#98765 attached. Sending to @anya_finance for vendor code mapping.

anya_finance: Got the PO. Vendor code confirmed as VC-5598. I'll create subaccount and kick off split invoicing. Expect invoices within 3 business days after signature.

elena_csm: Closing loop — sent redline to citrine counsel, they approved. DocuSign completed, PO attached. I'll update the renewal playbook with notes. :tada:
